_comment: NET-NEW wire shape (supervisor-silent-listen, design D3/D12, option B). POST /api/v1/supervisor/listen-endpoint answers 200 with this body to the CALLER ONLY: it provisions the caller's receive-only listen endpoint on first use (idempotent afterwards, the same credentials every time) and returns what the operations shell needs to REGISTER a SIP.js user agent over the tenant's Asterisk WSS URL (the console's existing getConfig().asteriskWssUrl). endpointId is the SIP user of the AOR (sip:{endpointId}@{domain}, domain derived from the WSS URL exactly as the agent softphone does); authorizationUsername and sipPassword are the digest credentials; displayName is the user's display name. sipPassword is the single place this secret crosses HTTP and is never returned by any list or admin route. The endpoint is NOT an Agent: no agents row, no licensed agent. Its id keeps the `-agent-` infix only because Pro's realtime sync names every desired endpoint `{tenantId}-agent-{slot}`; the slot is `sup-{userId}` and can never collide with an agent id (32 hex chars). The endpoint only RECEIVES calls: an INVITE from it is rejected by its dead-end dialplan context. Inbound listen INVITEs carry caller ID name `listenCallerName` and caller ID number = the conversation id being listened to; the console answers (receive-only, no microphone) only an INVITE whose caller number equals the conversation id of a listen it has just started or holds, and rejects any other INVITE. Refusals (fixtures/supervisor-listen-refusals.json): 403 not-permitted (caller lacks contacts:conversation:monitor); 409 no-supervisor-endpoint when the tenant id makes {tenantId}-{extension} longer than the 40-character SIP auth username (no credentials are returned). SIP contract: wire behaviour only: the AOR holds one contact (max_contacts 1, remove_existing yes), so any valid REGISTER takes the slot and the previous contact is removed; a listen INVITE reaches only the contact registered at that moment. When a console registers or re-registers is the consumer's decision. Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).
